name: qemu-guests
description: Concurrent QEMU Appium test guests with unattended provisioning and an independent Alpine Docker backend.

interface.shortDescription: Independent Appium test VMs and an Alpine Docker backend.
interface.longDescription: Manages concurrent QEMU work guests alongside one persistent Alpine Docker backend on Windows and in Linux containers. Includes Ubuntu cloud-init, Windows answer files and Intel macOS Recovery automation using prepared Apple media and a bootstrap package. Work guests install Appium for host-connected and manual testing, with no guest Docker proxy or backend credentials. The status panel lists work VMs and displays live read-only screens for supported graphical backends. Windows 11 hosts use a plugin-managed WHPX-only QEMU build for four-vCPU Windows guests and warm reboots. A unified run-test-env.sh entry point selects Docker/Testcontainers and transparent Appium artifact/file/service transport from project environment configuration; compilation stays on the host. Opt-in Ubuntu OpenGL uses a pinned Windows/WHPX VirGL runtime and a dedicated GPU desktop; its panel captures the GPU scanout through QMP on demand.
defaultPrompt: Install an unattended Appium work VM alongside the independent Alpine Docker backend.
Configure a custom unattended guest installation adapter.
